==History==
Squirtle, a human that became a Pokémon, decided to join Team Go-Getters along with Charmander and Chikorita. At first, he had trouble using his attack, which made him sad. The team got their first real mission to save a and his big brother, from a very territorial . After going through many trials, such as a cave full of -using and Team Meanies, the team saved the brothers and defeated Skarmory, with Squirtle finally mastering Water Gun.
